Datasets from my research, free to use and reuse under open licences, with an interactive explorer, a direct download, and the paper describing how they were built. Replication code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/philmkoch){target="_blank"}.

::: {.data-list}

::: {.data-entry}
[Historical GDP per capita for Europe and North America, 1300–2000](data/historical-gdp/index.qmd){.data-title}

Koch, P., Stojkoski, V., & Hidalgo, C. A. (2024). Augmenting the availability of historical GDP per capita estimates through machine learning. *Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences*, 121(39), e2402060121.

Machine-learning estimates of GDP per capita for 1,037 countries and regions, in 50-year steps over seven centuries, combined with the source data they were trained on. Estimates come with 90% confidence intervals.
